Note: Web and mobile permission constants use resource:action keys that must equal the backend strings exactly.

name: concept:platform/plan
observations: Definition: A subscription plan in public.plans. public.plan_resource_access lists the resources and actions it includes, and public.plan_menu_access lists the catalog menus it includes.
Note: Plans drive seeding, onboarding and super-admin screens; nothing checks them at runtime.

name: concept:platform/role
observations: Definition: A named role in the tenant roles table that users belong to and that resource_permissions and role_menu_permissions grant to. The JWT carries the role name, not its id.
Note: Canonical names are capitalised (Admin, Teacher, Staff, Student, Parent) and backend comparisons are exact and case-sensitive; custom roles are created through /admin/role-mgmt.
Note: There is no runtime role inheritance; role_inheritance and the public role and permission templates are unused.

name: concept:platform/template-schema
observations: Note: cos360_master is read-only and must never receive writes.
Note: cos360_masters (with an s) is a different schema used only as the auth service hard-coded fallback, and test_tenant_schema (client test_tenant) is the dev tenant.
Definition: cos360_master, the structure-only schema that new tenant schemas are cloned from and that migrations reach first. It holds no business data, and its resource_permissions table is empty.
Note: Cloning with LIKE ... INCLUDING ALL copies no foreign keys and copies enum column types by OID, so scripts/fix_tenant_enum_types.py must run after every clone.
Note: The client_name default falls back to cos360_master in get_tenant_db.

name: concept:platform/tenant
observations: Note: client_name is unique and is the value clients send; it maps to schema_name.
Note: client_name matching is exact and case-sensitive and names may contain spaces; mobile lowercases and trims what the user types.

Definition: A school using COS360: one row in public.tenants (client_name, schema_name, plan_id, is_active) plus its own PostgreSQL schema holding its business tables, users, roles, resource_permissions and menus.
Note: Only active tenants resolve; an unknown or inactive client_name gets 404 from get_tenant_db.

name: concept:platform/user-type
observations: Definition: Super admins live in public.super_admin_users and get tokens with user_type super_admin for /api/v1/super_admin routes only; every other user is a tenant user in the tenant users table with a role claim.
Note: A super-admin token has no role claim, so tenant permission checks deny it; super-admin routes use Depends(get_current_super_admin) instead.

name: concept:reports-dashboards/backend-menu
observations: Definition: The tenant's menus tree, scoped by plan and role and returned at login, that drives the web sidebar, the module hubs and part of the mobile home grid.

name: concept:reports-dashboards/background-export
observations: Definition: An export over the size thresholds, meant to be rendered by a Celery task, saved under exports/<tenant>/ and fetched later through the audit and download endpoints.
Note: Not used by any endpoint.

name: concept:reports-dashboards/module-hub
observations: Definition: A landing page for a module that shows one card per child of that module's backend menu node.

name: concept:reports-dashboards/report-audit
observations: Definition: A public.report_audit row recording a background export: user, tenant, report type, filters, format, file path/size, status and timestamps.

name: concept:reports-dashboards/report-group
observations: Definition: A family of report endpoints under /reports/<group> (students, staff, fees, attendance, financial) sharing one <group>_reports permission resource and one export endpoint.

name: concept:reports-dashboards/report-response
observations: Definition: Standard report envelope {data, total_count, page, page_size, total_pages}; rows are in data. Paged by page and page_size, date-filtered by date_from and date_to.

name: concept:reports-dashboards/report-type
observations: Definition: The report_type field of an export request naming which report to render (student_summary, staff_summary, fee_collection_summary, pending_fees, fee_structure, student_attendance, staff_attendance, expenditure, ledger).

name: concept:staff/designation
observations: Definition: A job title from the designations master (unique title); staff.designation_id points to it and it drives the drivers list.

name: concept:staff/driver
observations: Definition: A staff member whose designation title is exactly driver (case-insensitive); transport references drivers by user id.

name: concept:staff/qualification-level
observations: Definition: Qualification level enum with DB values Below Graduation, Graduation, Post Graduation and PhD; staff.qualification is a separate free-text legacy summary.

name: concept:staff/staff-active-flag
observations: Definition: staff.is_active is an HR flag that does not block login; login checks users.is_active, and the two are not kept in sync.

name: concept:staff/staff-enrollment
observations: Definition: A staff member is a users row (login) plus a staff row (HR record) created together; deleting staff removes the staff row, attendance and qualifications but not the user.

name: concept:students/admission-number
observations: Definition: The school's identifier for an admission and the student's login username; typed by hand or generated as {YEAR}{SEQ:04d} (pre_primary) or {SEQ:03d} (regular).

name: concept:students/admission-type
observations: Definition: Admission type is pre_primary or regular (AdmissionTypeEnum); it selects the admission number format and sequence. If omitted it is derived from student.is_primary == primary.

name: concept:students/attendance-status
observations: Definition: Daily attendance status: present, absent, late, half_day or leave (shared enum app/schemas/common/attendance_status_enum.py), one row per person per date.

name: concept:students/guardian
observations: Definition: An optional third parent (besides father and mother) stored as a parents row linked with relation guardian; it is created only when it has an email.

name: concept:students/is-primary
observations: Definition: student.is_primary has two meanings: in the admission UI not_primary = Day Scholar and primary = Hostel; in bulk upload and the backend fallback primary means Pre Primary.

name: concept:students/placeholder-date-of-birth
observations: Definition: The sentinel date 1900-01-01 (PLACEHOLDER_DATE_OF_BIRTH) stored when an admission has no date of birth.

name: concept:students/role-read-scope
observations: Definition: Student reads are role-aware via check_user_resource_access: Student own, Parent related (children linked in student_parent_links), Admin/Staff/Teacher all.

name: concept:students/shared-parent
observations: Definition: One parents row and one Parent login shared by siblings, matched by email at admission; edits through any child apply to all siblings.

name: concept:students/student-active-status
observations: Definition: Whether a student is active, stored on users.is_active; inactive students cannot log in and are hidden from active-only dropdowns.

name: concept:students/student-vs-admission-id
observations: Definition: List rows carry id = admission id and student.id = student id. /id/{student_id}, PATCH, toggle-active and photo routes take the student id; DELETE and /by-admission/{admission_id} take the admission id.

name: concept:tenants-and-admin/custom-role
observations: Definition: A tenant-created role (is_custom_role=true) whose rights come only from its resource_permissions; it gets no name-based behaviour and cannot be deleted while users are assigned.

name: concept:tenants-and-admin/permission-template
observations: Definition: A named bundle of resource:action grants applied to a role via apply-template. The live ones are hardcoded in permission_endpoints.py with stale resource names; public role_templates and permission_templates are legacy and unused.

name: concept:tenants-and-admin/super-admin
observations: Definition: A platform-wide operator stored in public.super_admin_users, separate from tenant users, whose JWT carries user_type super_admin.

name: concept:tenants-and-admin/system-role
observations: Definition: One of the five seeded roles Admin, Teacher, Staff, Student and Parent, protected by name from rename and delete.

name: concept:tenants-and-admin/tenant-admin
observations: Definition: A tenant user whose role grants user_management:* and role_management:*, normally the Admin role.

name: concept:timetable-calendar/frontend-timetable-format
observations: Definition: Wire format shared by both clients: {section_id, timetable_data:[{time:{from,to}, type, subjects:{Day: uuid}} or {time, type:special, label}]}.

name: concept:timetable-calendar/holiday-event
observations: Definition: A dated calendar entry for an academic year (name up to 50, description up to 100, start/end date, color, is_active). Holidays and events share one table with no type field; they differ only by name and colour.

name: concept:timetable-calendar/section-timetable
observations: Definition: One weekly timetable per section (timetables.section_id is unique), stored as timetables -> timetable_slots (one per day per period) -> timetable_subject_options, with times in slot_times.

name: concept:timetable-calendar/slot-time
observations: Definition: A section's period time range: slot_times row with label HH:MM-HH:MM, start_time and end_time.

name: concept:timetable-calendar/special-row
observations: Definition: A timetable row of type special with a label (Snacks, Lunch, Dispersal or a custom event) spanning every day; stored as is_break slots with break_label.

name: concept:timetable-calendar/subject-row
observations: Definition: A timetable row of type subject that assigns one subject UUID per day key (Monday..Saturday) for a time range.

name: concept:transport/fee-per-term
observations: Definition: The transport fee recorded on an assignment, defaulting from the pricing amount or stop fee; informational only, never read by the fee module.

name: concept:transport/route
observations: Definition: A named path with starting and ending stop names, a hand-typed number_of_stops, start and end times and is_active; route_name is unique.

name: concept:transport/route-stop
observations: Definition: A stop on a route with a sequence number (unique per route), pickup and drop times, the deprecated but still required reaching_time, and a whole-number default fee.

name: concept:transport/route-type
observations: Definition: A dictionary value (route_types.type_name) offered in route dropdowns; the route stores the chosen name as a plain string.

name: concept:transport/student-transport-assignment
observations: Definition: A student's link to a trip and a stop with fee_per_term and an optional pricing plan; not year-scoped.

name: concept:transport/student-trips-legacy
observations: Definition: The legacy student_trips table, which has no routed API; Student Trips screens are another view of /students/student-transport.

name: concept:transport/transport-pricing
observations: Definition: A billing-cycle plan (annual, semester, monthly or custom) for a vehicle and optionally one route, with an amount and a date range; active plans for the same vehicle, route and cycle may not overlap.

name: concept:transport/trip
observations: Definition: One vehicle running one route, with an optional driver and a trip_number; the unit a student is assigned to.

name: concept:transport/trip-type
observations: Definition: A dictionary value (trip_types.type_name) offered in route dropdowns; stored on the route as a plain string.

name: concept:transport/vehicle
observations: Definition: A school vehicle with a unique registration_number and free-text vehicle_type (Bus, Van, Auto).

name: endpoint:GET /fee/refunds/statistics
observations: Purpose: Refund dashboard numbers: counts by status, processed amount, counts by reason, monthly totals; filters academic_year_id, date_from, date_to on requested_date; permission fee_refunds:list.

name: service:app/middleware/error_middleware.py

name: service:app/middleware/request_context_middleware.py

name: service:app/middleware/tenant_middleware.py

name: table:board_exam_patterns
observations: Purpose: One row per board + level (unique) listing which exam types that board uses.

name: table:board_pattern_exam_types
observations: Purpose: Exam types belonging to a board pattern.

name: table:exam_audit_log
observations: Purpose: Append-only exam audit trail; exam_id has no FK so rows survive exam deletion.

name: table:exam_class_sections
observations: Purpose: Class-sections an exam is attached to; section NULL means the whole class; cascades on exam delete.

name: table:exam_config_template_items
observations: Purpose: One subject per template with its components stored as components_json.

name: table:exam_config_templates
observations: Purpose: Reusable subject-config template; name unique across all rows (uq_exam_config_template_name), soft-deletable.

name: table:exam_dates
observations: Purpose: Exam date per (exam, class, section, subject), unique; cascades on exam delete.

name: table:exam_grade_bands
observations: Purpose: Percentage bands (from_percent, to_percent, grade, GPA, pass flag) of an exam grade scheme.

name: table:exam_grade_schemes
observations: Purpose: Grand-total grade scheme referenced by exams.exam_grade_scheme_id.

name: table:exam_mark_entry_permissions
observations: Purpose: Exam-level mark-entry delegation rows (exam, user, is_active); cascades on exam delete.

name: table:exam_settings
observations: Purpose: Singleton tenant-wide exam settings row (hall-ticket attendance and fee thresholds and other defaults).

name: table:exam_streams
observations: Purpose: Stream table with no endpoints; exam_class_sections.stream_id is unused.

name: table:exam_subject_components
observations: Purpose: Components of a subject config: entry_type marks|remarks, max_marks, include_in_total, remark_grade_set_id.

name: table:exam_subject_config
observations: Purpose: One config per (exam, class, section, subject); optional subject_grade_scheme_id; cascades on exam delete.

name: table:exams
observations: Purpose: Exam header; exam_name + academic_year_id unique; board, level and exam_type are plain strings.

name: table:hall_ticket_eligibility
observations: Purpose: Per (exam, student) eligibility with attendance_ok, fee_paid, override flags, ineligibility_reason and hall-ticket number.

name: table:menus
observations: Purpose: Tenant-schema menu tree (parent_id) that feeds the login sidebar.

name: table:message_templates
observations: Purpose: Reusable templates: name + channel + body with {{var}} placeholders, derived variables list, is_active; (name, channel) unique.

name: table:notification_log
observations: Purpose: Permanent per-recipient audit record: rendered text, status sent/failed, provider_message_id, error_message, triggered_by.

name: table:notification_queue
observations: Purpose: Transient per-recipient processing state: rendered_message, recipient contact, status queued/processing/done/failed, target_type, target_ref JSON.

name: table:public.menus
observations: Purpose: Master menu definitions in the public schema that plans reference.

name: table:public.plan_resource_access
observations: Purpose: Permission layer 1 - plan_id, resource_name, actions[] and is_active per plan; created by SQL, not by an ORM model.

name: table:public.token_blacklist
observations: Purpose: SHA-256 hashes of logged-out tokens with expires_at; created lazily with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS by the blacklist service.

name: table:remark_grade_options
observations: Purpose: Letter + label options within a remark grade set.

name: table:remark_grade_sets
observations: Purpose: Named set of letter + label options used by remarks-type components.

name: table:student_exam_results
observations: Purpose: Computed exam totals, percentage, grade, GPA, rank and is_passed per student. FK to exams without cascade.

name: table:student_marks
observations: Purpose: One row per (exam, student, component, attempt_number); NULL marks_obtained means not entered; is_absent is separate. FK to exams without cascade.

name: table:student_subject_results
observations: Purpose: Computed per-subject-config result per student. FK to exams without cascade.

name: table:subject_grade_bands
observations: Purpose: Percentage bands of a subject grade scheme.

name: table:subject_grade_schemes
observations: Purpose: Per-subject grade scheme referenced by exam_subject_config.subject_grade_scheme_id.
